messages:
Alice R: heads-up — customers hitting a bunch of 413s when they send mixed long texts + high-dim arrays. thinking we should try a dynamic per-tenant max_payload_bytes instead of the global hard cap.
Bob K: can you sketch the algo? dynamic as in historical 95p + safety margin?
Alice R: yeah, something like: tenant_limit = min(global_max, max( fixed_floor, 95th_percentile(historical_payload_bytes) * 1.3 ))
Carol M: hmm. makes sense but quota accounting gets weird. if tenant_limit increases we need to make tokens reflect consumed bytes vs units. otherwise billing/console will be confusing.
Dan L: console UX concern: ops expect a single slider. If it's dynamic we need a clear indicator + explain why they saw a recent spike in fastfail. propose a small dashboard tile: "embed_frag_pct" (fraction of requests that needed splitting) + tenant_limit over time.
Ingrid S: also on runtime side: splitting on the wire causes more RPCs and KV cache misses. if fragmentation goes up we should route to a split-optimized path. can we add a routing policy: if payload_bytes > split_threshold && frag_pct > 0.2 -> route to splitter pool.
Bob K: routing policy ok, but we should avoid creating hot paths. maybe use a probabilistic routing rule during rollout: p = min(0.5, frag_pct * 2) so we ramp.
Alice R: agreed. rollout plan: 1) telemetry only for 48h (emit embed_frag_pct, tenant_limit, split_route_rate) 2) soft-tokens experiment: instead of hard reject, decrement a "soft-byte-token" bucket with a looser limit and return `x-embed-soft-remaining` header. 3) if soft-token exhausted -> 413.
Carol M: soft-tokens help signal to clients. please ensure we also surface `x-embed-estimated-splits` so SDKs can pre-split and avoid retry loops.
Dan L: I can add a console hint: show estimated_splits on the request example and a one-click toggle to opt-in to pre-splitting in SDK quickstarts. also add a sparkline for frag_pct and a heatmap for bytes-by-dim.
telemetry-bot: metric emitted: embed_frag_pct=0.078 last1h, avg_payload_bytes=18342, tenant_sample=acme-corp
Alice R: nice — frag is low on sample but peaks cause most 413s. when we start soft-token experiment let's make the default soft limit = tenant_limit * 1.5 and log every soft-hit as WARNING.
Ingrid S: runtime impl note: splitter pool needs to return a “merged trace id” so downstream traces tie back to original request. otherwise debugging gets painful.
Bob K: can we add an event in the audit timeline so SREs see when a request was split+rerouted? small event with original_ts, split_count, route_ids.
Carol M: billing question: are we charging on pre-split tokens or final per-chunk tokens? need legal on that. for experiment maybe mark soft-splits as non-billable.
Alice R: good catch — let's make soft-splits free for 2 weeks. we can toggle afterwards.
Dan L: action items: 1) eng-platform prototype dynamic limit function + metrics (Bob, Ingrid) 2) runtime splitter trace & merged id (Ingrid) 3) console tiles + SDK hint (Dan) 4) billing guardrail + non-billable soft-splits (Carol) 5) 48h telemetry-only run then 1-week soft-token opt-in (Alice)
Bob K: I'll open a PR with the dynamic limit code and unit tests. link when ready.
Alice R: thanks. keep messages short in the rollout doc — customers skim. :thumbsup:
